headline: Deadlocked adds game, network and menu matches across US and PAL
summary: Deadlocked's progress report reaches 5.57% matched code by size on NTSC-U v1.00, with 4,151 of 18,085 functions. The final progress commit records 4,553 of 18,113 functions for PAL SCES_532.85. Matching means the reconstructed C compiles to the original game's bytes.
highlights: #46 covers game, network and engine code, while #47 adds engine and library work shared where compatible with PAL.
#45 lands 450 PAL reconstructions, and #43 adds PAL menu and other routines. Duplicate PAL copies were removed where shared C already matched the same functions.
TTY read and write wrappers now match on US and PAL (#41).
The day's 51,929 added lines include 34,083 in a progress-report refresh, so line totals do not directly measure new game code.
Tempus Station PAL work and an assembler change intended to unblock more PAL functions remain open (#48, #49). The five-function draft #44 closed without merging.
